children: Cuentas Inc. reported second-quarter 2026 results with a widened loss: net income of $(0.89M) for Q2 2026 and a six-month loss of $(1.39M), compared with a six-month loss of $(21K) a year earlier. Diluted EPS for the six months was $(0.21), versus $(0.01) in the prior-year six-month period.
Net income: $(0.89M) for Q2 2026; six months ended 6/30/2026 net loss $(1.39M) versus $(21K) for six months ended 6/30/2025 (widened loss).
Diluted earnings per share: $(0.21) for six months ended 6/30/2026, versus $(0.01) for six months ended 6/30/2025.
Quarter comparison: Q2 2026 net loss $(0.89M) versus net income $0.38M in Q2 2025 (year-ago quarter decline).
MVNO consolidation and operations: Company consolidated its majority-owned World Mobile joint venture (51%), operating an MVNO with U.S. spectrum, roaming agreements and an AirNode network.
Product focus and channels: Continued emphasis on Cuentas Mobile cellular services and digital fintech offerings targeting the Hispanic/Latino market through retail and wholesale channels.
Market positioning: Leveraging the Cuentas brand to build trust with Spanish-speaking and underbanked customers, offering prepaid and GPR card solutions.
Operational milestone: Delivered fintech assets under a 16-month license and initiated deployment plans for a portal and fintech capabilities to expand digital product sales.
Resource management: Continued operations with core executives and select employees accepting deferred pay to support legal, compliance and commercialization efforts.
